# Zentrix

> Zentrix turns a company's processes into simple tools: apps the team uses in the store and on the street, connected to its management system. It is the new brand of Equinoccio (EQNIO), the software engineering, applied-AI and product team based on Isla Margarita, Nueva Esparta, Venezuela, with clients in Venezuela, Latin America, the United States and Europe.

Slogan: «Technology to work better». eqnio.com redirects to zentrix.company. Spanish version: [llms.txt](https://zentrix.company/llms.txt).

## Products

- [Zentrix Work](https://zentrix.company/en/work/): Store teams
- [Zentrix Sales](https://zentrix.company/en/sales/): Field sales
- [Zentrix Check](https://zentrix.company/en/check/): The security gate
- [Zentrix AI](https://zentrix.company/en/ai/): Applied intelligence
- [Zentrix Logistics](https://zentrix.company/en/logistics/): Warehouse to doorstep
- [Zentrix Cloud](https://zentrix.company/en/cloud/): Infrastructure
- [Zentrix Labs](https://zentrix.company/en/labs/): Research
- [Zentrix Software](https://zentrix.company/en/software/): Odoo® implementation
- [Traza](https://traza.technology): A Zentrix® product (own site)

## Solutions

- [Odoo in Venezuela](https://zentrix.company/en/solutions/odoo-venezuela/): Implementation with Venezuelan localization
- [Software development](https://zentrix.company/en/solutions/software-development/): Web and mobile apps built around your process
- [Technical audit](https://zentrix.company/en/solutions/technical-audit/): Diagnosis, architecture and roadmap
- [High availability](https://zentrix.company/en/solutions/high-availability-infrastructure/): Infrastructure that keeps running through outages
- [Payments and digital commerce](https://zentrix.company/en/solutions/payments-and-digital-commerce/): Point of sale, tills and payment gateways
- [Computer vision](https://zentrix.company/en/solutions/computer-vision/): Real-time video analytics
- [All solutions, by need and by sector](https://zentrix.company/en/solutions/)

## Company

- [About Zentrix and the team](https://zentrix.company/en/about/): founded in 2024 as Equinoccio, based on Isla Margarita, Venezuela
- [Customers](https://zentrix.company/en/customers/): Grupo Leiros and GUUAO, where our apps run every day
- [Resources](https://zentrix.company/en/resources/): documentation, support, privacy and terms of each product
